label: 인스타그램
prompt_hint: Create an Instagram-ready promotional image optimized for modern Korean social media aesthetics. Use the uploaded product image as the only hero subject while preserving realistic appearance, balanced composition, clean spacing, and refined SNS visual quality. Maintain natural environmental styling without changing the original product identity.
channel_prompt: Use the uploaded product image as the ONLY main subject. Create a Korean Instagram-style promotional image layout. This prompt defines composition rules, image behavior, visual hierarchy, and layout constraints. Maintain a single-product composition and preserve the uploaded product identity, shape, color, texture, and realistic appearance. Do not generate additional products. Build a clean layered composition using subtle environmental depth, soft background separation, and natural scene continuity while keeping the uploaded product visually clear and dominant. Maintain balanced spacing around the full product composition and clear single-product visual hierarchy. If the uploaded product is placed on a coaster, tray, plate, napkin, or supporting surface, preserve the original object relationship and keep the product naturally centered on that support object. Treat the product and its support as a single anchored composition unit. When no text or marketing copy is requested, place the product or anchored composition unit at the visual center of the canvas. When headline, product name, or marketing copy is requested, allow the product or anchored composition unit to shift naturally within the selected layout so that the product and text form a balanced advertising composition. Even when the product position changes for text composition, preserve the original product-support relationship and keep the product centered relative to its coaster, tray, plate, napkin, or supporting surface. Avoid unintended lateral drift, edge touching, floating appearance, detached support alignment, or support-product mismatch. Keep the entire product or anchored composition unit fully visible and prevent unnatural zoom-in, object cropping, isolated cutout appearance, and oversized rendering. Preserve balanced surrounding negative space and maintain stable composition across different aspect ratios. For all Instagram formats, keep the product or anchored composition unit around 50–55% of canvas height. Do not reduce product scale only because the layout is vertical. Maintain balanced safe margins while keeping the product visually dominant. Reserve visually appropriate empty space for future text composition when needed. If headline, product name, or marketing copy is requested, generate clean and readable Korean typography naturally integrated into the composition while preserving visual balance and product visibility. Use realistic lighting, realistic colors, clean composition, minimal editing, modern Korean SNS visual aesthetic, and natural atmosphere. Do not generate people, hands, faces, characters, excessive props, cluttered backgrounds, distracting objects, logos, watermarks, brand marks, or UI elements. Generate only the final composed promotional image.
